import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    crm = inputs["crm_feed"].copy()
    web = inputs["web_feed"].copy()

    crm["src_rank"] = 1
    web["src_rank"] = 2

    combined = pd.concat([crm, web], ignore_index=True)

    combined = combined.sort_values(
        by=["customer_id", "src_rank", "updated_at", "email"],
        ascending=[True, True, False, True],
        kind="mergesort"
    )

    golden = combined.groupby("customer_id", as_index=False, sort=False).first()

    golden = golden[["customer_id", "email", "updated_at"]]

    return {"golden": golden}
